name: RS4
description: The Audi RS4 is the most powerful version of the A4, produced in collaboration with quattro GmbH. From the twin-turbocharged 2.7-litre biturbo V6 of the B5 (1999) — which produced 380 hp and set the standard for the super-saloon segment — to the current B9 with a naturally aspirated 4.0-litre V8, each RS4 has represented the definitive German sports estate.

generations.description: The B5 RS4 (1999–2001) introduced the RS4 nameplate with a 380 hp twin-turbo 2.7-litre V6 biturbo, quattro AWD, and avant-only bodystyle.
